title: Passenger Airline Network & Commercial Control Tower (Singapore Airlines) data contract
description: Field-name contract for the Singapore Airlines (SIA) executive 'Network & Commercial Control Tower' demo. Pre-aggregated fact tables so every dashboard sheet is single-table (extract-workbook technique). 100% synthetic (MockData=1), calibrated to SIA published FY2024/25 GROUP figures; money in SGD; English labels. Generator (services/factory/app/generators/singaporeair.py) emits matching columns; workbook templates reference only fields listed here.

monthly_performance.description: Month grain (Jan-2024..Dec-2025). Headline commercial KPIs with same-month prior-year values for clean YoY.

region_performance.description: 6 network regions × snapshot — revenue, pax, PLF, yield index, capacity share, YoY growth.

destinations.description: ~28 SIA destinations with real Lat/Lon (for the custom-lat/lon bubble map) — pax, revenue, PLF by city.

cabin_class.description: 5 cabin classes (Suites/First/Business/Premium Economy/Economy) — revenue mix, seat share, yield index, load factor.

loyalty_krisflyer.description: Month grain — KrisFlyer total members, net adds, tier mix (base/silver/gold/PPS), redemptions, ancillary revenue.

metric_dictionary.description: One row per metric: definition, unit, cadence, favorable direction, source. Powers the agent's 'explain metric' capability.
